title: Hyper-Aperiodic Colorings from Aperiodic SFT Colorings
answer: No full proof or counterexample established.
exact_scope: Countably infinite discrete Gamma; finite k>=2 and q>=1; original q-symbol SFT S; Borel input and output; closure of entire coding image must be free.
strongest_partial_result: If each nonidentity element of Gamma has infinite centralizer, the antecedent implies that S contains a nonempty compact free subshift. This does not establish a Borel map into it.
partial_result_dependencies: Authored Baire essential-image/centralizer argument in analysis.md
other_verified_results: Uniform finite-witness characterization of whole-image hyper-aperiodicity
Compact free subshift with a parity-factor obstruction to Borel universality
Monotone SFT counterexample candidate fails the required Borel antecedent
exact_gap: Construct a Borel coloring into the original q-symbol SFT with one finite separating witness set per group element valid at every source point, or exhibit an SFT satisfying the original antecedent but excluding all such colorings.

controls.scope: Finite algebra and local-language controls only; infinite and Borel claims require the written proofs.

literature_status: No full resolution identified in targeted current-source review; not an exhaustive open-status certification.
publication_scope: Authored analysis, finite controls, public bibliographic references and verification metadata only.
